title: Three free Claude plugins let you scrape almost anything off the internet
description:
Scraping the web used to mean paying for an API or babysitting scripts that break every time a site changes. These three free Claude plugins fix all of it.

ScrapeGraphAI: tell it what you want in plain English, get back clean structured data instantly. No selectors, no parsing.

Agent Reach: pulls from gated platforms like LinkedIn, Instagram, X, and Reddit, with no API key required.

Scrapling: already past 70,000 GitHub stars because it rewrites itself when a site changes its layout, so your setup keeps working instead of breaking every few weeks.

Simple sites, locked platforms, constantly changing pages. Together these three cover almost every situation you'll run into, with no subscription and no maintenance.

Comment SCRAPE and I'll send them over.
